methodology: Option A: Independent Single-Set SSR for Six Constructs (Maier et al. adaptation)
embedding_notes: Local Ollama nomic-embed-text (768 dims) used instead of paper's OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536 dims) for 100% offline, local execution.

construct_responses.PE: The performance of this phone sounds top-notch with the Snapdragon 8 Elite processor. It will handle all my work and study tasks with ease, and the multitasking will be a breeze. The 120W charge will be a game-changer for me, as I can quickly charge my phone when needed.
construct_responses.EE: The Android OS is user-friendly, and I’m familiar with it. Transitioning from my iPhone shouldn’t be too difficult, and the Hasselblad triple camera will be a fun addition. The 2K AMOLED display and the premium materials will make the phone feel luxurious.
construct_responses.HM: The display and camera will be great for gaming and streaming. The 1-inch Hasselblad camera will give me professional-quality photos, and the smooth performance will make me enjoy using the phone more. The sound quality and display will be amazing, and I'll definitely have a lot of fun with this phone.
construct_responses.SI: My friends and college buddies will be jealous of the phone's look and performance. It’s a status symbol and a conversation starter. They’ll recommend it to others, and I’ll feel like I’m part of a tech-savvy community.
construct_responses.PP: The personal data privacy and security features on this phone will give me peace of mind. I don’t have to worry about my data being compromised, and the built-in security is a plus.
construct_responses.BI: Yes, I would definitely consider buying it. The premium features justify the flagship price, and I’ve been wanting a new phone for a while now. The Hasselblad camera and 2K display are exactly what I need, and the performance will be unmatched.
construct_responses.OVERALL: Overall, this phone is a great buy for someone who wants the best of the best. The features are impressive, and the price seems justified given what you get. I’m excited to get my hands on it.
